settings.label: Reply time shown after sending
settings.info: Shown in the confirmation box after a visitor submits the contact form, e.g. "We usually reply within 24 hours".

settings.label: Offer pop-up slot
settings.info: Master switch for the event pop-up. Shows once per visitor per event (after 3 seconds or their first scroll). PawScout events wake this slot automatically with their own wording, so leave it on unless you never want any offer pop-up; the fields below are only the fallback shown if PawScout is unreachable.

settings.label: Supporting line
settings.default: On top of free UK delivery on every order.

settings.label: Discount code
settings.info: Must match the code created in Shopify admin. Every button in the modal applies it automatically via the discount link.

settings.label: End date line
settings.info: Shown as typed, e.g. "Ends 20 July". Leave empty to hide. State the event's real end date only - no invented urgency.

settings.label: Offer end date (YYYY-MM-DD)
settings.info: The modal hides itself after this day and derives its "Ends" line from it, overriding the free-text line above. The live storewide event from PawScout takes precedence over both when reachable.

settings.label: Search shortcuts (comma-separated)
settings.default: Cat trees, Cooling mats, Litter boxes, Dog beds

settings.label: Browse button text
settings.default: Start shopping with the offer applied
